사도행전 20:1.content: And after the uproar was ceased, Paul called unto him the disciples, and embraced them, and departed for to go into Macedonia.

사도행전 20:2.content: And when he had gone over those parts, and had given them much exhortation, he came into Greece,

사도행전 20:3.content: And there abode three months. And when the Jews laid wait for him, as he was about to sail into Syria, he purposed to return through Macedonia.

사도행전 20:4.content: And there accompanied him into Asia Sopater of Berea; and of the Thessalonians, Aristarchus and Secundus; and Gaius of Derbe, and Timotheus; and of Asia, Tychicus and Trophimus.

사도행전 20:5.content: These going before tarried for us at Troas.

사도행전 20:6.content: And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread, and came unto them to Troas in five days; where we abode seven days.

사도행전 20:7.content: And upon the first day of the week, when the disciples came together to break bread, Paul preached unto them, ready to depart on the morrow; and continued his speech until midnight.

사도행전 20:8.content: And there were many lights in the upper chamber, where they were gathered together.

사도행전 20:9.content: And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus, being fallen into a deep sleep: and as Paul was long preaching, he sunk down with sleep, and fell down from the third loft, and was taken up dead.

사도행전 20:10.content: And Paul went down, and fell on him, and embracing him said, Trouble not yourselves; for his life is in him.

사도행전 20:11.content: When he therefore was come up again, and had broken bread, and eaten, and talked a long while, even till break of day, so he departed.

사도행전 20:12.content: And they brought the young man alive, and were not a little comforted.

사도행전 20:13.content: And we went before to ship, and sailed unto Assos, there intending to take in Paul: for so had he appointed, minding himself to go afoot.

사도행전 20:14.content: And when he met with us at Assos, we took him in, and came to Mitylene.

사도행전 20:15.content: And we sailed thence, and came the next day over against Chios; and the next day we arrived at Samos, and tarried at Trogyllium; and the next day we came to Miletus.

사도행전 20:16.content: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus, because he would not spend the time in Asia: for he hasted, if it were possible for him, to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost.

사도행전 20:17.content: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called the elders of the church.

사도행전 20:18.content: And when they were come to him, he said unto them, Ye know, from the first day that I came into Asia, after what manner I have been with you at all seasons,

사도행전 20:19.content: Serving the Lord with all humility of mind, and with many tears, and temptations, which befell me by the lying in wait of the Jews:

사도행전 20:20.content: And how I kept back nothing that was profitable unto you, but have shewed you, and have taught you publickly, and from house to house,

사도행전 20:21.content: Testifying both to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.

사도행전 20:22.content: And now, behold, I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem, not knowing the things that shall befall me there:

사도행전 20:23.content: Save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions abide me.

사도행전 20:24.content: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.

사도행전 20:25.content: And now, behold, I know that ye all, among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God, shall see my face no more.

사도행전 20:26.content: Wherefore I take you to record this day, that I am pure from the blood of all men.

사도행전 20:27.content: For I have not shunned to declare unto you all the counsel of God.

사도행전 20:28.content: Take heed therefore unto yourselves, and to all the flock, over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers, to feed the church of God, which he hath purchased with his own blood.

사도행전 20:29.content: For I know this, that after my departing shall grievous wolves enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

사도행전 20:30.content: Also of your own selves shall men arise, speaking perverse things, to draw away disciples after them.

사도행전 20:31.content: Therefore watch, and remember, that by the space of three years I ceased not to warn every one night and day with tears.

사도행전 20:32.content: And now, brethren, I commend you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build you up, and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified.

사도행전 20:33.content: I have coveted no man’s silver, or gold, or apparel.

사도행전 20:34.content: Yea, ye yourselves know, that these hands have ministered unto my necessities, and to them that were with me.

사도행전 20:35.content: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.

사도행전 20:36.content: And when he had thus spoken, he kneeled down, and prayed with them all.

사도행전 20:37.content: And they all wept sore, and fell on Paul’s neck, and kissed him,

사도행전 20:38.content: Sorrowing most of all for the words which he spake, that they should see his face no more. And they accompanied him unto the ship.
